$description: AgentOS Button style resolution, API mapping, and compatibility rules aligned to the local Figma *Button* set.

rules: if state=focus and no dedicated focus token exists -> use hover appearance
if state=disabled -> override with shared disabled treatment

notes.primary: Theme=Primary, Type=Default aligns with Ant primary button.
notes.outline: Type=Outline aligns with the Ant default stroked button.
notes.ghost: Type=Ghost aligns with the Ant ghost button.
notes.secondary: Custom local theme; not a native Ant theme.
notes.black: Custom local theme built on Brand/Tertiary tokens.
notes.danger: Custom local danger theme; mapped through theme=danger instead of the Ant danger boolean.

notes: These fallbacks are for local React preview only and are not part of the source-of-truth Figma spec.
Round shape remains a preview fallback until the live Figma set adds a Shape axis.
